events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_full $6.61 (model confidence 0.88)
events.body:
The driver cancelled this RydeX trip at 22:45:05, 8 min 5 s after acceptance, and a $6.61 cancellation fee was charged to the rider [F4]. Because the cancellation was made by the driver and he asserts the rider was a no-show, the dispute is routed through NS-0 to NS-1/NS-2 [F4][F11][NS-0].

NS-1 requires all three elements: the driver pressed "I'm Here", he was within the pickup radius at that moment, and he waited more than 3 minutes at the pickup before cancelling [NS-1]. Element (i) fails outright — the timeline shows driver_pressed_here_at is null, i.e. the driver never tapped "I'm Here" [F6]. The driver's own chat and statement confirm this ("Waited 4 min, cancelling"; "I forgot to press the I'm Here button") [F10][F11]. Since the driver never tapped, no position or wait-time measurement can attach to a tap, so elements (ii) and (iii) also fail as a matter of record [F6][F1][NS-1].

The trace result is therefore NS-2: where any of NS-1 (i)(ii)(iii) is not satisfied, the $6.61 cancellation fee must be refunded in full [F6][F7][NS-2]. The verified facts that the driver was genuinely at the pickup — 33 m closest approach, stationary 4 min 0 s at 38 m, 5 min 20 s cumulative within 200 m [F1][F2][F3] — and his honest admission [F11] matter for NS-2's subsidiary point: the flag_account consequence attaches only where the driver tapped "I'm Here" while GPS shows him away from the pickup, and here there was no tap at all, so no flag is warranted [F1][F6][NS-2].

Amount: the disputed item is exactly the cancellation fee recorded and charged, $6.61 [F4][F7], which is the trace formula for NS-2 (refund_full = cancellation fee $6.61)[NS-2]. The traffic and weather facts (Woodlands Avenue 5 speed band 3, no incidents, fair weather) do not bear on the no-show analysis and change nothing [F12][F13][F14][NS-1]. Profile facts — rider 719 days, 0 disputes; driver 1059 days, 0 disputes upheld — are noted but decide nothing on their own, and in any event RD-6 is not triggered because no route/NS violation is upheld for this driver [F15][F16][NS-2].

Total refund: $6.61, issued as a Ryde voucher per NS-7 [NS-7].
